_description: Mapping template: DrawEM32 cortical regions -> MCRIBS (M-CRIB-S) Desikan-Killiany parcellation, 68 cortical regions (34 per hemisphere).
_how_to_use: For every MCRIBS/Desikan-Killiany region below, list the DrawEM32 source labels that overlap it. A source label is the thickness column name without the hemisphere prefix ('lh_'/'rh_') and without the '_thickness' suffix (e.g. column 'lh_dwm_07_thickness' -> label 'dwm_07'). The same label list is applied to both hemispheres. Several DrawEM32 sources may feed one MCRIBS region; they are combined with the method set in 'aggregation'. Validate this correspondence against your own atlas documentation before using the results.
